description: React component for a Tic Tac Toe game with trash talk feature, including game logic, UI components, and trash talk settings management.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Calculates the winner of the Tic Tac Toe game based on current board squares.

methods.name: emptyBoard
methods.description: Creates an empty 3x3 Tic Tac Toe board represented as an array of nulls.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Functional component representing a single square button on the game board.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: Functional component representing the 3x3 game board UI.

methods.name: normalizeTone
methods.description: Normalizes trash talk tone value to predefined options.

methods.name: normalizeFrequency
methods.description: Normalizes trash talk frequency value to predefined options.

methods.name: shouldTriggerTrashTalk
methods.description: Determines if trash talk should trigger based on frequency, event type, and move count.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing game state, UI, and trash talk logic.

methods.name: requestTrashTalk
methods.description: Handles debounced request to generate trash talk line via external service.

methods.name: handlePlayAt
methods.description: Handles user move at a specific board position, updates game state, and triggers trash talk if appropriate.

methods.name: handleJumpTo
methods.description: Allows jumping to a specific move in history, resets trash talk state.

methods.name: handleNewGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state and clears trash talk.
